recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If Pharmacy or NCPDP supplies additional mappings for MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationStatement, or other resources, handle that as new work rather than as a missing application of FHIR-8050.
issue_request: FHIR-8050 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from the DSTU1 era asking to add NCPDP mappings to Medication resources; Jira comments record that mappings for Medication and MedicationOrder were added and that the issue was closed because no additional mappings had been provided.
initial_application: The explicit source application was commit e6bfd3ac62 ([#8050] NCPDP mapping for Medication and MedicationOrder), which added the NCPDP SCRIPT 10.6 mapping space and mappings in the Medication and MedicationOrder spreadsheet sources.
additional_context: The current build-scope authority lists MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, MedicationStatement, and Medication as active Medication-domain resources, and records MedicationOrder as renamed to MedicationRequest. Current source retains SCRIPT 10.6 mappings for Medication and MedicationRequest. MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, and MedicationStatement have no SCRIPT 10.6 mapping entries, but Jira explicitly says no additional mappings were provided.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Adding invented or empty NCPDP mappings to the other active Medication-domain resources would exceed the applied work-group decision and would not be backed by supplied mapping content.
